host: node packages/wasix-sysroot/test/run-modes.mjs --tarball <package.tgz>: builds test/modes.c against the tarball with the pinned wasixcc and runs test/modes.mjs on the kernel's Node entry; the same with --probe r18 for -18's test/r18.c and --probe r19 for -19's test/r19.c, --probe r22 for -22's test/r22.c, --probe r23 and --probe r23fork for -23's test/r23.c and test/r23fork.c, --probe r24 for -24's test/r24.c (R24_USERS=report|enforce|off) and --probe r24link for its linkat fix, --probe r25 for -25's test/r25.c (R25_USERS=enforce|report|off), --probe r26 for -26's test/r26.c, --probe r27 for -27's test/r27.c, once per variant: default (sysroot-exnref-eh), --variant ehpic (sysroot-ehpic, the PIC libc wasix-python links), exnrefpic (sysroot-exnref-ehpic), eh (sysroot-eh) and noeh (sysroot, which wasixcc asyncifies itself, so r23fork's no-asyncify ENOSYS case is skipped there; R19_SIGSTATE=1 on a kernel with slicc-kernel#260 adds the /proc/<pid>/status SigIgn/SigCgt read-back). The sysroot (160 MB) is too big for a browser-cert page.
checklist: slicc_fs native (the kernel answers the imports)
umask() returns the kernel's 022; umask 027 → open(O_CREAT, 0666) gives 640
open(O_CREAT|O_TRUNC, 0600) → 600; O_EXCL 0640 → 640; openat 0600 → 600; reopen with O_CREAT keeps 755
mkdir 0700 → 700; mkdirat 0777 → 755
fchmod 0644, chmod 0755, fchmodat 0700
fchmodat NOFOLLOW on a symlink → ENOTSUP; chmod of a missing path → ENOENT
read back inside WASIX: stat/fstat report the same bits as coreutils' stat (fd_mode / path_mode); lstat sees the symlink
on a kernel without slicc_fs (1.34.1 and older) the same program exits 0 with upstream behaviour (run-modes.mjs --allow-absent)

create cost (run-bench.mjs: 2000 × open(O_CREAT|O_TRUNC)+write+close, 10 interleaved rounds, medians vs the published -15): a mode the kernel already gives (0644 under 022) costs nothing extra; a fresh 0600 one fd_chmod; reopening an existing file with a non-default mode one failed O_EXCL open; mkdir 0700 one path_chmod. On 1.34.1: no change
